title: Bridging the gap in online hate speech detection: a comparative analysis of BERT and traditional models for homophobic content identification on X/Twitter
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance of machine learning models (specifically BERT and traditional classifiers) in detecting homophobic hate speech. While homophobia is a topic involving societal values, the paper's research objective is content classification and dataset creation, not the evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical philosophies.
